widgets_values: Edit propagation: each edited frame shows exactly how that moment of the video should look after the edit. Apply the same changes to every frame of the clip, before, between and after the edited frames, so the edit stays consistent through the whole video. Keep the guide video's motion, timing, camera movement, composition and all unedited content unchanged.
